### Organizational Relationships and Reporting Paths

* **Group Executive Board Reporting:**
  * If an entity is **NorthStar Software (NSS)**, then it reports directly to the **NorthStar Group Group Executive Board**.
  * If an entity is **NorthStar Field Services (NSFS)**, then it reports directly to the **NorthStar Group Group Executive Board**.
  * If an entity is **Shared Services**, then it reports directly to the **NorthStar Group Group Executive Board** and serves both NSS and NSFS.

* **NorthStar Software (NSS) Sub-departments:**
  * If a department is **Product & Engineering**, then it reports to **NorthStar Software (NSS)**.
  * If a department is **Customer Success**, then it reports to **NorthStar Software (NSS)**.
  * If a department is **Sales & Partnerships**, then it reports to **NorthStar Software (NSS)**.

* **NorthStar Field Services (NSFS) Sub-departments:**
  * If a department is **Installation Crews**, then it reports to **NorthStar Field Services (NSFS)**.
  * If a department is **Maintenance & Repair**, then it reports to **NorthStar Field Services (NSFS)**.
  * If a department is **Site Safety Office**, then it reports to **NorthStar Field Services (NSFS)**.

* **Dotted-line Reporting:**
  * If the department is the **Site Safety Office**, then it also has a dotted-line reporting relationship to **Legal & Compliance** (part of Shared Services) for incident investigations.

Figure 3:
This is a flowchart diagram illustrating the "Expense Claim Approval Flow".

### Flowchart Rules and Paths

1. **Submission:** An expense claim is submitted in the HR Hub (within 30 days of trip end / purchase).
2. **Receipt Check:**
   * **If** the original receipt is **not** attached (No), **then** a "Lost Receipt Declaration (form F-17) - max. 2 per quarter" must be completed before proceeding to the claim amount check.
   * **If** the original receipt is attached (Yes), **then** proceed directly to the claim amount check.
3. **Claim Amount (incl. VAT) Check:**
   * **If** the claim amount is **<= 150 EUR**, **then** it is "Auto-approved after Finance receipt check", and then "Reimbursed with the next payroll run (cut-off: approvals completed by the 20th of the month)".
   * **If** the claim amount is **150.01 - 1,000 EUR**, **then** the "Line manager approves", and then "Reimbursed with the next payroll run (cut-off: approvals completed by the 20th of the month)".
   * **If** the claim amount is **1,000.01 - 5,000 EUR**, **then** approval is required by "Line manager + Cost-centre owner", and then "Reimbursed with the next payroll run (cut-off: approvals completed by the 20th of the month)".
   * **If** the claim amount is **> 5,000 EUR**, **then** approval is required by "Line manager + Cost-centre owner + CFO Office", and then "Reimbursed with the next payroll run (cut-off: approvals completed by the 20th of the month)".

---

### Note
No self-approval: if you are your own cost-centre owner, the next level up approves.

Figure 8:
This is an informational graphic displaying four document classification labels with their respective handling rules.

### Classification Labels - how to mark and handle documents

* **PUBLIC**
  Approved for external release. Examples: website texts, published release notes. Printing: allowed.

* **INTERNAL**
  Default for all company documents. Share inside NorthStar only. Printing: allowed, collect immediately.

* **CONFIDENTIAL**
  Need-to-know. Encrypt when sent externally. Examples: contracts, salaries, customer data. Printing: secure-print (badge release) only.

* **RESTRICTED**
  Named individuals only. Never send by external e-mail. Examples: M&A plans, security keys, investigations. Printing: PROHIBITED.

### Polaris PREMIUM Support - Response Targets

| Severity | Definition | Polaris Cloud first response | Polaris Edge first response | Status updates |

| **P2** | Major function impaired, workaround exists | 2 hours (24/7) | 4 hours (24/7) | Every 8 hours |
| **P3** | Minor issue, limited impact | 1 business day | 1 business day | Every 3 business days |
| **P4** | Question or feature request | 3 business days | 3 business days | Weekly |

Premium plan includes a named Technical Account Manager.
Polaris Edge P1: on-site engineer within 24 h (EU) or 48 h (other regions).
Targets apply from the moment the ticket is logged in the customer portal.
